newsitem.title: CHINA: Kone breaks ground in China venture.
newsitem.headline: Kone breaks ground in China venture.

text.p: Kone Corporation, the Finnish elevator maker, broke ground on its first joint venture in China on Monday, a $29 million factory near Shanghai, a company statement said.

Kone Elevators (Kunshan) Co will begin production in the second quarter of 1998 with annual production initially exceeding 1,600 units for office buildings, hotels and shopping complexes, the statement said.
"China's reforms and open-door policy...have turned China into the largest and most dynamic construction site in the world," Kone Vice Chairman Antti Herlin was quoted as saying.
"The building spree has created a strong demand for the development of an advanced domestic elevator industry," he said.
The Chinese partner is Jiangsu Xinji Group Co, it said, but gave no details.
